description: Agenda actions rule: the operations a viewer may take on an item.

cases.inputs: meeting InProgress; actor: Chair; item Pending; items: [item Pending, another Pending]; hasMinutes: false.
preconditions: Running meeting; Chair; item Pending; no item in progress.
cases.return: CanEdit true; CanEditPlanningFields true; CanDelete true; CanSetCurrent true; CanComplete false; CanRecordConclusion false; CanLinkDocuments true.

cases.inputs: meeting InProgress; actor: Chair; item Pending; items include one InProgress.
preconditions: Running meeting; Chair; another item is already in progress.
cases.return: CanSetCurrent false; CanEdit true; CanDelete true.

cases.inputs: meeting InProgress; actor: Chair; item InProgress.
preconditions: Running meeting; Chair; the item is in progress.
cases.return: CanComplete true; CanDelete false; CanSetCurrent false; CanRecordConclusion true; CanEdit true.

cases.inputs: meeting InProgress; actor: Secretary; item Pending.
cases.return: CanEdit true; CanDelete true; CanSetCurrent false; CanComplete false; CanLinkDocuments true (execution actions are for the Chair only).

cases.inputs: meeting Published; actor: Chair; item Pending.
cases.return: CanEdit true; CanDelete true; CanSetCurrent false; CanComplete false (meeting not running).

cases.inputs: meeting InProgress; actor: Member; item Pending.
meeting Ended; actor: Chair; item Done; hasMinutes: false.
preconditions: Ended meeting; Chair; item Done; no minutes.
cases.return: CanEdit false; CanDelete false; CanSetCurrent false; CanComplete false; CanRecordConclusion true; CanLinkDocuments false (meeting ended).

cases.inputs: meeting Ended; actor: Secretary; item Done; hasMinutes: true.
